# The Vois 2.0 Upgrade: Faster, Smarter, More Expressive

Vois Team

TLDR:Vois 2.0 is a major upgrade: a faster on-device model with Fast, Expressive, and Multilingual modes plus Omni (600+ languages and Voice Design on Pro), 100+ voices across 21 categories, native voice cloning, GPU acceleration (up to 6x on Apple Silicon), CLI automation, and simpler subscription pricing.

Vois 2.0 was built for the point where a good voice is not enough. Creators also need to revise a line, keep a recurring narrator consistent, finish the mix, and export without sending the script through a cloud workflow. [...] The update puts that work in one local studio: choose a voice, build the script, generate, arrange, master, and export. If you need a custom narrator or a multilingual version, those choices now sit inside the same project rather than becoming a second tool chain.

Vois remains desktop-native and local. The new release adds more ways to make the outcome fit the project, while keeping scripts, audio, and voice samples on the machine where you are working.

## Choose the engine for the job

Vois 2.0 gives you distinct voice engines rather than one compromise setting.

Fast is for English drafts and quick revisions. It generates at about three times real time on a standard CPU, and on supported Apple Silicon Macs it can reach about six times real time with GPU acceleration. [...] ## Let an agent handle repeatable production

Vois 2.0 includes a local CLI for repeatable production work. An AI agent can use the hosted Vois skills to create projects, prepare scripts, assign voices, generate batches, and export using a mastering profile. The app remains the local studio that performs the work.

Prompt your agent: "Read the Vois CLI skill at . Create a local project for this script, propose voice assignments and an export profile, but show me the plan before generating or exporting anything."

Expected deliverable: a project plan, proposed voice IDs, a script structure, and the intended export destination.

results.title: VOIS - Real transformations inside your DAW
results.content:
#####

The version available on our website is an audio plugin (VST3/AU/AAX). It does not launch as a separate program and requires a host DAW (like Pro Tools, Logic Pro, FL Studio, or Ableton Live) to run.   
  
 If you are looking for the standalone application that runs without a DAW, it is available exclusively via the Apple App Store.

#####

We are currently compatible with Pro Tools (AAX) as well as DAWs that use Audio Units (AU) and VST3 formats. This includes FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro, and Cubase on both macOS and Windows.

##### [...] #####

If you are using Pro Tools 2022.9 or newer, VOIS now utilizes ARA support. It will no longer appear in the Inserts menu; instead, it is located in the ARA plugin selector on the track header (next to the Elastic Audio algorithm selector).   
  
 If you are running a legacy version of Pro Tools that does not support ARA, you can download the non-ARA version here: macOS | Windows.
